# Goal
Compute the background distribution on different bin sizes.
Then use that to compute the zscore for each of the PB-SB integrations and the individual SB integrations.



# Setup
```{r load_libraries}

# Load dependencies
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(gtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggh4x)
library(stringr)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)

library(BSgenome.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10)
library(Biostrings)
library(ggseqlogo)
library(ShortRead)
library(GENOVA)

library(ggbeeswarm)
library(scales)
# library(pheatmap)
# library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}

source('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_background/CM20260330_compute_chromatin_background.R')
```


```{r}
#location of the pipeline output files
path_context_500 ='/DATA/shared/projects/local_hopping/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/genomewide_background-500_summary.txt'
path_context_2000 = '/DATA/shared/projects/local_hopping/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/genomewide_background-2000_summary.txt'
path_context_5000 = '/DATA/shared/projects/local_hopping/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/genomewide_background-5000_summary.txt'
path_context_10000 = '/DATA/shared/projects/local_hopping/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/genomewide_background-5000_summary.txt'

#features we want to process
features_oi = c("'H3K9me3_pADam'", "'LB1_pADam'" , #heterochromatin
                "'EZH2'", "'H3K27me3-2i'", #polycomb
                "'RAD21'" , "'CTCF'", #3D genome
                "'H3K27ac-2i'", "'p300-2i'", #euchromatin
                "'ATAC'", "'DNase'", #accessibility
                "'H3K36me3'", "'POLR2A'", "'TTseq_fw'", "'TTseq_rv'", #transcription
                "'MED1'", "'H3K4me1'", "'H3K4me3'", #CRE
                "'input_1'", "'input_2'" #input samples
                )

#load the tibbles
context_tib_oi_500 = read_tsv(path_context_500) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))

context_tib_oi_2000 = read_tsv(path_context_2000) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))

context_tib_oi_5000 = read_tsv(path_context_5000) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))

context_tib_oi_10000 = read_tsv(path_context_10000) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))


blacklist_bed = read_tsv('/DATA/shared/projects/local_hopping/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_context/encode_mm10_blacklist.v2.bed', col_names = c("chr", "start", "end", "type"))

#calculate backgrounds
background_sum_500 = chrom_background(context_tib_oi_500, 
                                       blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")) 


background_sum_2000 = chrom_background(context_tib_oi_2000, 
                                       blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")) 

background_sum_5000 = chrom_background(context_tib_oi_5000, 
                                       blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")) 


background_sum_10000 = chrom_background(context_tib_oi_10000, 
                                       blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")) 

#remove big tibbles again
rm(context_tib_oi_500, context_tib_oi_2000, context_tib_oi_5000,context_tib_oi_10000)
gc()
```

```{r}
contexts_combined = bind_rows(`500` = background_sum_500, `2000` = background_sum_2000,
                              `5000` = background_sum_5000, `10000` = background_sum_10000, .id = 'window_size')
```
